autoplay.description: Play provably safe foundation moves automatically (when the rules allow it).

max_states.description: Stop after visiting this many distinct positions.

shorten.description: Shorten winning lines by cutting out detours (default true).

timeout_ms.description: Stop after this many milliseconds of wall-clock time (native targets only).

oneOf.description: Depth-first, heuristic ordering. Can prove unsolvability.
Best-first by heuristic. Can also prove unsolvability, at a higher memory cost.
Best-first for a share of the budget, then depth-first with the rest.
